name: find_member_by_name
description: Look up one member by name and return only their numeric id and name. Use this first whenever the user refers to a member by name, because the other tools need the numeric id. Name matching is exact and case-sensitive ('Minh' does not match 'minh'); if no member is found, tell the user instead of guessing other spellings. This tool does not return any messages: use get_member_messages for that.

name.description: Exact member name as written by the user, for example 'Minh'

name: get_member_messages
description: Return the messages of one member by numeric member_id, optionally filtered by event type. Use it to read or list a member's messages, and to find the message_id needed before deleting one. Do not use it to look a member up by name (call find_member_by_name first) and do not use it to change or delete anything. Returns an empty list when the member has no message of the requested type.

member_id.description: Numeric member ID, obtained from find_member_by_name

event_type.description: Only return messages of this event type. Omit it to return all of the member's messages.

name: delete_message
description: Permanently delete one message of one member. Use it only when the user explicitly asks to delete a message; never use it to look anything up. The deletion cannot be undone, and the user is asked to confirm before it runs. Take member_id from find_member_by_name and message_id from get_member_messages, and never guess ids.

member_id.description: Numeric ID of the member who owns the message

message_id.description: Numeric ID of the message, unique only within that member's messages
